sourceAudit.repositoryDefinitionSearch: no changeHujia method definition or prototype assignment found in the tracked source tree; references are call sites and diagnostics only

sourceAudit.interpretation: source-level unresolved implementation gap; do not infer armor mutation semantics or repair without explicit native-rule authorization

sourceAudit.tempSkills: Player.addTempSkill stores a skill-keyed expiry that may be a trigger descriptor or function; GameEvent.trigger removes expired entries and removes the skill
sourceAudit.additionalSkills: Player.addAdditionalSkill/addAdditionalSkills mutate skill-keyed strings or arrays, affecting getSkills and later trigger/legality evaluation
sourceAudit.when: Player.when creates a random player_when skill with dynamic filter/content/vars and may retain closures or generated functions; trigger completion removes that skill and its lib.skill/translation entries
sourceAudit.extraXingDong: xingDong step 0 resets the queue; Player.addExtraXingDong and native skills can push payload objects; step 4 pops them LIFO and calls the named native action with the payload
sourceAudit.extraXingDongPayload: payload may contain xingDong, prompt, forced, filterCard, filterTarget and createDialog; callback fields and arbitrary object spread prevent a generic canonical representation
sourceAudit.markStorage: reviewed guiHuo is a bounded special case only; general marks are read from heterogeneous player.storage and player.marks includes UI state
sourceAudit.canonicalizationDecision: no general extractor accepted; preserve unsupported and fail closed until each rule-relevant family has a typed allowlist, lifetime boundary and native evidence

unsupported: arbitrary event result and callback payloads
